child.label: Convention & Politics
child.description: Questions about whether the answerer prefers conventional, traditional, and mainstream ways or unconventional ones, including views on law and order, politics, and challenging accepted positions.
child.not_for: Curiosity, love of ideas, creativity, imagination, reading, and noticing art or beauty (use Ideas & Imagination).
examples: Do you like to be seen as proper and conventional?
Do you believe laws should be strictly enforced?
